title: 第631章 这叫高效第630章 上清教育队
lines: 激流喷射者的水柱刚把最前方三具傀儡轰得四分五裂，李齐麟身形便骤然一矮。
甲胄背部喷口轰然爆发，白色尾焰如龙蛇一般在竹林间一卷，整个人当即化作一道铁色残影，直直撞向剩下的四具傀儡。
轰！
最前方那具傀儡还来不及转过空洞的眼眶，李齐麟便借助推进器的蛮横动力，一记膝顶，硬生生将傀儡撞得粉碎。
紧接着，庞大的甲躯在半空中做出不可思议的变向，一记沉重的鞭腿扫出，再次踢爆一具傀儡。
借着回旋的力道，李齐麟顺势反手拔剑。
乌沉沉的不讲武德剑在掌甲中严丝合缝地扣紧，剑脊两侧细密的缝隙倏然裂开。
内里的锯齿链带呼啸而出，在灵机驱动下高速旋转，发出令人牙根发酸的狂暴切割声。
一剑横扫！
锯齿链带如饿兽般撕咬而过，将一具傀儡拦腰嚼断。
切口处火星狂喷，铁屑如血雾般漫天溅射，断裂的上半身尚未落地，下半截残躯还惯性地往前走了一步，才轰然坍塌。
“呼，这刀可真好使！”
李齐麟稳稳落地，顺势挽了个刀花，摆出一个自认为十分帅气的造型。
“哎卧槽，倒是给我留一个啊！”
左炎扛着蛟龙炮，声音在通讯频道里急了起来：“你们都要打完了，我打什么？”
钱伟兴看着面甲里仅存的傀儡标记，说道：“这不是还有一个吗？”
左炎更不乐意了：“可我蛟龙炮都拿出来了，就给我一个？！”
李齐麟还在装，淡淡道：“手慢无。”
左炎一时无言，默默将蛟龙炮架稳，掌甲扣住发射机栝。
炮身上，黑鳞状的甲片一层层亮起，水蓝色的灵光沿着内部通道急速汇聚，前端龙嘴发出一声低沉的闷啸。
轰！
一道粗逾水桶的深蓝水柱爆射而出，沿途撕裂空气，正中最后那具傀儡。
那具可怜的傀儡连碎片都来不及留下，在水柱触及的瞬间便直接化为齑粉。
水柱去势不减，轰然贯穿竹林，一路撞向后方的山体。
只听一声沉闷巨响，半面崖壁轰然塌陷，碎石裹在水流中朝山后奔涌而去，滚滚白浪冲得山间雾气都四散开来。
“这不大炮打蚊子吗？”
左炎扛着炮，看着远处崖壁上那个森然的黑洞，多少有些不得劲，“这跟空放有什么区别？”
但轰隆声消散后，山林深处却又传来了窸窸窣窣的声响。
原来是刚才一炮的动静惊动了沉寂在营巧山各处的残破傀儡，它们有的从碎石堆中爬出，有的从断肢残件里挣扎起身，还有几具体型庞大的铁傀从山坳间缓缓转过身来，空洞眼眶中灵光忽明忽灭。
焦黑竹林间，一时间尽是机关轴承转动的咔嗒声，密密麻麻地围拢过来。
“咦，还有挺多的。”
钱伟兴眼睛又亮了。
李齐麟也重新握紧了不讲武德剑，锯齿链带再次嗡鸣作响。
“我来我来！”
左炎赶紧提前预定。
但这一次，通讯频道里先响起的，是邵光暮冷酷的声音。
【指挥官·邵光暮】：“第七小队，你们当前任务是寻找潜在的鸽子督办，而不是在这里和傀儡玩成一片。”
“收到。”
既然指挥官发话了，那就只好速战速决。
钱伟兴心念一动，腰间一枚短杵状的法器自动脱离挂载，落入掌甲之中。
content_en:
As soon as the jet of water from the torrent blasted the three puppets at the front to pieces, Li Qilin's figure suddenly dwarfed.
The nozzle on the back of the armor exploded, and white tail flames rolled through the bamboo forest like a dragon and snake. The whole person immediately turned into an iron-colored afterimage and crashed straight into the remaining four puppets.
boom!
Before the puppet at the front had time to turn its empty eyes, Li Qilin used the brute power of the propeller to smash the puppet with a knee.
Immediately afterwards, the huge armored body made an incredible change in mid-air, swept out a heavy whip leg, and kicked a puppet to pieces again.
With the power of the spin, Li Qilin took advantage of the situation and drew his sword with his backhand.
The dark, dark martial arts sword was tightly clasped in the palm of the hand, and the fine gaps on both sides of the sword's spine suddenly opened.
The zigzag chain belt inside roared out, rotating at high speed driven by the machine, making a violent cutting sound that made the teeth aching.
Sweep with one sword!
The jagged chain belt bit through like a hungry beast, chewing up a puppet at the waist.
Sparks spurted out from the incision, and iron filings spattered all over the sky like blood mist. Before the broken upper body hit the ground, the lower half of the body still took a step forward with inertia before suddenly collapsing.
"Huh, this knife is really easy to use!"
Li Qilin landed firmly, took advantage of the situation to make a sword gesture, and put on a pose that he thought was very handsome.
"Oh shit, leave one for me!"
Zuo Yan was carrying the dragon cannon, and his voice became anxious in the communication channel: "You are all finished fighting, what should I fight?"
Qian Weixing looked at the only remaining puppet mark in the visor and said, "Isn't there another one?"
Zuo Yan was even more dissatisfied: "But I have already taken out the dragon cannon, just give me one?!"
Li Qilin was still pretending and said calmly: "You are too slow."
Zuo Yan was speechless for a moment, silently mounting the dragon cannon and holding the transmitter on his palm.
On the body of the cannon, the black scale-like armor plates lit up layer by layer, aqua blue light quickly gathered along the internal passage, and the dragon's mouth at the front made a low muffled roar.
boom!
A column of dark blue water as thick as a bucket burst out, tearing the air along the way and hitting the last puppet.
The poor puppet didn't even have time to leave any fragments behind, and turned into powder the moment the water column touched it.
The water column continued unabated, crashing through the bamboo forest and crashing into the mountain behind.
There was only a dull and loud sound, and half of the cliff suddenly collapsed. The rubble was wrapped in the water and rushed towards the back of the mountain. The rolling white waves rushed away and the mist in the mountain dispersed.
"Isn't this cannon used to kill mosquitoes?"
Zuo Yan carried the cannon and looked at the eerie black hole on the cliff in the distance, feeling somewhat uncomfortable, "What's the difference between this and empty firing?"
But after the rumble dissipated, rustling sounds came from deep in the forest.
It turned out that the sound of a shot just now had disturbed the broken puppets that were silent all over Yingqiao Mountain. Some of them crawled out from the rubble, some struggled to get up from the broken limbs, and several large iron puppets slowly turned around from the mountain col. The light in their empty eyes flickered on and off.
The charred bamboo forest was filled with the clicking sound of machine bearings for a while, and they were densely surrounded.
"Hey, there are quite a few more."
Qian Weixing's eyes lit up again.
Li Qilin also tightened his grip on the Wushuode sword again, and the sawtooth chain belt buzzed again.
"I'll come, I'll come!"
Zuo Yan quickly made a reservation in advance.
But this time, the first thing that sounded on the communication channel was Shao Guangmu's cold voice.
[Commander Shao Guangmu]: "Team 7, your current task is to find potential pigeon supervisors, not to play with puppets here."
"Roger that."
Now that the commander has spoken, we have to make a quick decision.
With a thought in Qian Weixing's mind, a short pestle-shaped magic weapon on his waist automatically detached from its mount and fell into his palm.
